**State as of year 200 (post Turn-1 ruling):** industrial (replicator) mass 1.89e11 kg; collectors 8.48e11 kg; radiators 8.42e11 kg @300K; power captured 1.20e16 W; compute 4.35e29 ops/s (radiator-bound); memory 4.35e26 bytes; total built/mined mass 1.88e12 kg of 2.51e25 kg accessible rock across ~2.5-3 systems within 5.8 ly (1.76 Lsun combined).
